Definition: from G2596; and G3695; to equip fully with armor:--arm.
BiblicalUsage: Kathoplizo means to arm fully, to equip with armour from head to foot. Luke 11:21 pictures a strong man armed keeping his palace, his goods in peace, until a stronger than he comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no armour we put on ourselves can stand against the stronger man, Christ, who takes the spoil.
